actions.name: export_work_citation
actions.description: Export one DOI as BibTeX, RIS, CSL JSON, a formatted citation, RDF, Turtle, or UNIXREF XML.

doi.description: The DOI of the work, such as 10.1038/nphys1170. A doi.org URL is also accepted.

format.description: The citation or metadata format to export.

style.description: A Crossref CSL style identifier used only with formatted output, such as apa.

locale.description: A Crossref locale identifier used only with formatted output, such as en-US.

mailto.description: An email address that identifies the caller to Crossref and enables the polite API pool.
